title: Product Manager, Dashboard
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid).

If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

• Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform

• Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users

• Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions

• Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell

• Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel

• Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments

About You:

• You've built and shipped developer-facing products

• You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies

• You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple

• You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces

• You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions

Bonus If You:

• Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt

• Have an engineering background or have built software yourself

• Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context

• Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages

Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring

title: Accounting Senior Manager - CPG Team Lead
description:
Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.graphitefinancial.com) built to help startup and high-growth companies scale efficiently and sustainably. Graphite Financial is redefining the “finance department” for early-stage companies and VC-backed startups. We deliver high-caliber accounting and finance leadership and support to entrepreneurs and management teams building scalable, high-growth companies. Our clients are actively managing cash burn, measuring performance, reporting to investors, making capital allocation decisions, and preparing for fundraising. All of that takes expertise and time that founders don’t have and can’t afford to hire for. Graphite bridges the gap with flexible, fixed-fee support packages that provide fractional leadership and operational support from CFOs, Controllers, FP&A Managers, and Tax leaders.
ROLE PURPOSE
Ensure high-quality, consistent client delivery across an assigned team of CPG-focused Client Leads and staff by enabling, coaching, and coordinating their work. The Accounting Senior Manager - CPG Team Lead is accountable for team effectiveness across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods clients - not just individual client outcomes. This role requires both delivery leadership and people leadership, and carries formal responsibilities for performance reviews, career coaching, and development planning.
CPG is a demanding vertical. Clients in this space deal with trade promotion complexity, multi-channel revenue structures, inventory and landed cost challenges, and margin pressure that requires precision at every level. The Team Lead must be fluent enough in CPG accounting to coach Client Leads through these challenges credibly - and to recognize quality work product when they review it.
WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED HERE
This is a fully remote leadership role within a client-facing professional services firm. You lead a team of Accounting Managers (Client Leads), Senior Associates, and Associates serving CPG clients who expect Graphite -quality accounting every month. The following qualities define what high performance looks like at this level.
• CPG Accounting Fluency: You understand CPG accounting at a practitioner level - trade spend, deductions, landed cost, inventory reconciliation, gross-to-net revenue across channels. You do not need to prepare every reconciliation yourself, but you need to review one and know immediately whether it is right.
• Leadership Without Proximity: You set clear expectations, provide consistent coaching, and hold your team accountable - entirely through remote communication and structured operating rhythms. Your presence is felt through the quality of what your team produces.
• Client Credibility: You maintain the technical depth and professional presence to engage senior CPG client contacts directly when needed. Your team’s standards reflect yours - invest in both.
• Coaching Over Fixing: Your job is to make Client Leads better - not to do their work for them. When something goes wrong on a CPG engagement, your first instinct is to coach, not to take over.
• Responsiveness at Scale: You model the responsiveness you expect from your team. Delayed decisions and slow escalations create client risk in a fast-moving industry. Move fast, communicate clearly, and resolve things.
• Accountability for Team Outcomes: You own what your team delivers across the CPG portfolio. You do not deflect to process or capacity. You identify problems early and solve them.
• Professional Standards Enforcement: You hold Client Leads and Associates to a high bar for written communication, client interaction, and deliverable quality. This is not optional in a remote, client-facing environment.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
Team Enablement & Oversight
•Coach Client Leads on solution design, client management, delivery approach, and professional judgment across CPG engagements
•Review CPG client engagement approaches for technical risk, complexity

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:

Introduction:

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role  

Sitting at the intersection of analytics, data engineering, and Ecom stakeholder support, this hands-on technical role owns Retail Media and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) analytics for the Enablement & Martech team. Operating within the Partner Success department, you will partner closely with international retail partners operating the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) to turn business metric definitions into precise, trusted technical logic. You will also play a key role in expanding into Ecom Analytics Engineering as we build out reporting marts and establish a new semantic layer.

Beyond technical delivery, you will act as a pivotal liaison between Analytics Engineering, Product, and commercial stakeholders to define, govern, and migrate core Ecom metrics. You will drive Looker governance, provide actionable digital performance analysis, automated reporting workflows, and champion best practices across the business while mentoring junior team members.

Key Responsibilities

• Own Retail Media analytics, including building and troubleshooting Looker Explores, resolving data-quality issues, and scoping aggregation tables to optimize performance.

• Act as the analytics liaison to Analytics Engineering for building reporting marts and prioritizing metric migrations.

• Automate recurring Retail Media and partner performance reporting to eliminate manual effort and boost data reliability.

• Conduct digital performance analyses using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to inform partner and internal stakeholder decision-making.

• Drive Looker governance across the organization, including content certification, naming conventions, and data-source standardization.

• Deliver ad-hoc and ticketed technical analysis for Ecom and retail partner stakeholders as business priorities evolve.

• Present data-driven insights and strategic recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Mentor junior analysts and champion analytical best practices across the team.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

• Strong technical proficiency in SQL and BigQuery alongside proven experience building and maintaining Looker Explores and reports.

• Some practical experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for digital and ecommerce analytics.

• Proven track record translating complex or ambiguous business requirements into well-documented technical metric definitions.

• Solid understanding of data modelling concepts and experience collaborating with Analytics Engineering on semantic layers and reporting marts.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• A self-starter mindset focused on automating repeatable processes, with hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude) to accelerate analytical workflows.

Nice to Haves

• Experience in retail media, onsite advertising measurement, or familiarity with Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM).

• Experience building or maintaining a metric dictionary, data glossary, or semantic layer.

• Programming experience in Python or R, or holding a GA4 / Google Analytics certification.

• Deep understanding of ecommerce customer behavior, digital performance metrics, or experience in a te

title: Java Developer | Sênior - AI Gateway (13493)
description:
Vaga 100% remota
Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Atuar tecnicamente na evolução do Sensedia AI Gateway, a camada inteligente que governa, protege e escala o uso de Inteligência Artificial e agentes nas empresas, atuando como ponto único de controle entre os sistemas dos clientes e os grandes modelos de linguagem (LLMs). Este papel exige forte capacidade técnica, visão sistêmica de engenharia e autonomia para propor, desenvolver e sustentar soluções de alta qualidade em um produto cloud-native de fronteira, colaborando com arquitetos, lideranças técnicas e times multidisciplinares na construção de uma plataforma robusta, escalável e segura para o ecossistema de IA agentic.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

• Atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de desenvolvimento do AI Gateway, contribuindo para decisões técnicas relevantes na evolução do produto.

• Desenhar, desenvolver e evoluir o control plane do produto (Java/Spring Boot), responsável por traduzir operações de gerenciamento em recursos Kubernetes (CRDs) que configuram o data plane em tempo de execução.

• Contribuir para a evolução das capacidades centrais do produto: roteamento para LLM Providers com failover, políticas de guardrails (Prompt Guard, Prompt Enrichment, Rate Limiting), exposição de APIs corporativas como MCP Servers, gestão de AI Agents, scopes e credenciais.

• Colaborar com arquitetos, team leaders, Product Managers e demais pessoas do time para transformar necessidades de produto em implementações viáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.

• Participar de análises técnicas, discussões de trade-off, discovery técnico e provas de conceito para validar caminhos de implementação e reduzir riscos, especialmente em um domínio em rápida evolução como o de IA agentic (MCP, A2A e protocolos emergentes).

• Evoluir integrações com múltiplos provedores de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Bedrock e modelos open-source), garantindo independência de provedor e consistência de comportamento.

• Desenvolver e evoluir fluxos seguros de autenticação e autorização baseados em OAuth, JWT/JWKS e scopes, incluindo a integração com Keycloak e auth servers externos dos clientes.

• Aplicar boas práticas de resiliência, observabilidade (OpenTelemetry), segurança, governança e excelência operacional nas soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir tecnicamente para a evolução da solução, ajudando a identificar oportunidades de melhoria, redução de complexidade, ganho de escala e mitigação de riscos.

• Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time de engenharia, apoiando decisões técnicas, revisões de código, refinamentos e melhoria contínua da qualidade técnica.

• Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, arquitetura, testes, observabilidade e operação dentro do time.

• Investigar problemas técnicos, propor soluções e atuar na sustentação evolutiva da plataforma com foco em qualidade, estabilidade e escalabilidade.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

• Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) sênior em produtos digitais, plataformas cloud-native ou sistemas distribuídos.

• Experiência sólida com Ja

The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
 
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Spreedly Product Offering:
Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect - A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault - A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize - Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect - A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve - Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26
--
 
What It's Like to Work Here:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
 
--
 
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI-if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
 
--
 
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.
 
Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.
 
At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.
 
We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.

We are looking for an experienced Windows Engineer to manage and support enterprise Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, patching, virtualization, security, and high-availability environments. • Support backup, restore, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities.

• Automate repetitive administration tasks using PowerShell.

• Monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring and logging platforms.

Windows Server Windows Server 2016/2019/2022/2025

Active Directory AD DS, OU, Users, Groups, FSMO, Sites & Services

DNS/DHCP DNS zones, records, DHCP scopes, troubleshooting

Group Policy GPO creation, configuration, troubleshooting

PowerShell Scripting, automation, administration

Patching WSUS, SCCM/MECM or equivalent

Virtualization VMware vSphere and/or Microsoft Hyper-V

Security Windows hardening, security baselines, endpoint security

Networking TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing basics, firewall concepts

Monitoring Windows monitoring, event logs, performance counters

Backup/DR Backup, restore, replication and DR concepts

ITSM Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management

Good to Have

• Microsoft Azure / Azure Virtual Machines

• Microsoft Entra ID / hybrid identity

• Microsoft Intune

• Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

• SCCM/MECM administration

• Windows Failover Clustering

• IIS administration

• Certificate Services / PKI

• VMware vCenter and ESXi

• Automation using PowerShell

• Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms

• Knowledge of enterprise monitoring tools such as SCOM, SolarWinds, Dynatrace, or equivalent

• Experience supporting large-scale data center environments

Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.

We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.

Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

THE ROLE:

Airbyte is looking for an Engineering Manager, Platform to lead the team responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering systems that power Airbyte Cloud, Airbyte Flex, and Airbyte Agents.

As an Engineering Manager on the Platform team, you'll lead the engineers responsible for cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that powers engineering velocity across the company. Your work directly shapes both how fast engineers ship and how customers experience Airbyte. This isn't a keep-the-lights-on role. You'll make real tradeoffs between engineering velocity, customer-facing reliability, and long-term architecture every week, and you'll help define how AI transforms the way we build and operate software.

This role combines people leadership, technical strategy, operational excellence, and platform thinking. You'll help define how engineering works at Airbyte - not just what we build.

- Invest in and drive adoption of AI-powered workflows for debugging, release validation, infrastructure management, and developer productivity, moving past experimentation into real operational leverage.

- Lead incident response, run blameless postmortems, and ensure systemic fixes follow every outage. Continuously reduce operational toil through automation.

- Build leverage: a week-long task this year should take ten minutes next year.

 

SUCCESS METRICS:

- Engineers deploy with confidence and ship faster quarter over quarter.

- Platform reliability improves as measured by customer-facing SLAs, not just internal dashboards.

- Operational toil decreases through automation, not heroics.

- Incidents are detected faster, resolved faster, and the same failure doesn't happen twice.

- Your team is engaged, growing, and building careers they're proud of.

Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

We’re looking for a fast, creative, forward-thinking professional who has a strong background in retention. You’re the right fit for this role if you are comfortable with figuring things out as you go, defaulting to action, and adapting to additional responsibilities. You’ll have a proven record of achieving your goals and the goals of your team.

What you get to do every day

• Provide comprehensive, end-to-end support to our key partners, acting as a relationship manager. Employ proactive and reactive measures to ensure a "white glove" experience for our most valued payroll partners.

• Serve as the primary point of contact within Human Interest for all payroll and CPA partners, providing general reactive support and handling escalations.

• Act as a liaison between internal teams to facilitate the development and implementation of solutions, and ensure these resolutions are communicated effectively to partners.

• Develop, propose, and implement solutions tailored to partner needs to increase retention and satisfaction.

• Assist with maintaining and further developing the partner support teams' standard operating procedures documentation. 

• Communicate any blockers or potential risks to leadership as soon as they arise to mitigate potential risks to reputation. 

• Always be ready to share your wins and what you're working on to show leadership the impact you're making and help shape what we do next.

What you bring to the role

• 3+ years of experience working in a Partnership, Sales, and/or business development environment

• 3+ years of experience with innovative strategic partnerships for consumer-facing, web services, and SAAS products

• Demonstrated capacity to anticipate partner needs, identify challenges proactively, and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment, all while sustaining a positive attitude.

• You don't wait for others to act on your behalf; you proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they escalate.

• Experience in developing and leveraging strategic insights to foster and/or improve business relationships

• Ability to translate complex business problems into easy-to-understand concepts for external stakeholders

• Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills using tools such as Google Docs, Google Slides, Google Sheets, and/or equivalent Microsoft products

• Experience facilitating meetings, handling external partner escalations, and conducting proactive service outreach

• Experience using a CRM platform (preferably Salesforce) to forecast sales and draw insights from service performance metrics

• Strong understanding of the Human Interest partner process, demands and needs for continued success

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. title: Data Centre Technician - Barcelona, Spain
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do: 

The Data Centre Operations team is at the physical core of our business, responsible for building, maintaining, and operating the cutting-edge infrastructure that powers the cloud. This team ensures the stability, security, and scalability of our physical assets, working hands-on in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment to deliver a best-in-class experience for our clients. 

About the role: 

The Data Centre Technician will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data centre operations. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics, followed by physical repair, and includes maintenance of data centre operations to ensure service availability. You will be responsible for root cause analysis of failures, training internal teams, and developing documentation or scripts to update server and networking hardware. As part of this 100% on-site role, you must be able to respond to on-site equipment failures within 60 minutes while scheduled on-call and travel up to 10% of the time to other locations as required.

Who You Are: 

• Computer Hardware experience, including troubleshooting and assembling.

• Linux Operating System experience.

• Ability to regularly transport and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.

• Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods and maneuver in cramped or elevated spaces, such as ladders or under-floor areas.

• Ability to perform tasks requiring fine motor skills for handling small hardware components and cables.

• Availability to work a flexible schedule within a 24/7 environment, including participating in a rotating on-call shift.

• Excellent time management, organisational, and communication skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and react quickly to issues.

• Ability to perform essential job duties in environments with fluctuating temperatures ranging from 60°F to 90°F.

Preferred:   

• Experience with Computer Networking.

• Python, Bash, or other scripting languages experience.

• Experience with Cisco IOS and/or Juniper JunOS.

• An Associate's Degree or equivalent experience in an IT-related field.

Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

• You love to solve complex physical and technical problems through hands-on repair.

• You're curious about root cause analysis and improving data centre reliability.

• You're an expert in hardware diagnostics and maintaining critical infrastructure.

Why CoreWeave? 

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

title: Senior Manager of Marketing Operations
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof is scaling its marketing team to support a major expansion from online notarization into portable digital identity for banks, lenders, insurers, and wealth managers. To invest well, we need the systems, data, and processes that show exactly how marketing creates pipeline and revenue.
As Director of Marketing Operations, you'll own the marketing technology stack, lead lifecycle, attribution, and reporting that make the whole team faster and more accountable. Day to day, you'll work closely with Revenue Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Finance to keep data clean, programs running, and leadership confident in marketing's impact.

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.
 
Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our product team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. title: Logistics Quality Control Specialist
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Logistics Team

- Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Decide what lives on site, what lives an hour out, and what lives twelve hours out. We're building the material disposition strategy from scratch for a fleet scaling across multiple sites at once, and getting that placement logic right is the difference between a blocked site and one that never stops.

- Move off third-party warehousing and stand up our own. We're transitioning out of 3PL-run warehouses and building the operation in-house, on our own footprint and our own rules.

- Build and integrate our own warehouse, inventory, and transportation management systems. No off-the-shelf stack covers a build at this scale, so the systems get built and connected in-house, end to end.
 

ROLE SCOPE

- Inspect inbound freight at site receiving docks, from IT skids and racks to cabling and electrical gear, and document condition, count, and damage against the packing list before anything is signed for.

- Run every shortage, concealed damage, and mis-ship claim from first photo to resolution, with the carrier notice and insurance documentation that gets freight replaced or paid.

- Score carriers, 3PLs, and warehouse operators on on-time, in-full, damage-free delivery, and drive corrective actions when a lane or vendor slips.

- Verify serials, condition, and disposition on returned hardware so failed parts move back to vendors and good inventory returns to stock fast.

- Write the receiving inspection standards, packaging and handling specs, and defect reporting that every site runs the same way.

title: Senior Software Engineer, JAX
description:
NVIDIA is hiring senior engineers to develop its AI platform and more specifically its performance optimizations in deep learning frameworks using JAX, a tool that can differentiate between Python control code and NumPy code. Our goal is to deliver a polished, fast, modular and coordinated platform to handle data, training and analysis for a wide range of deep learning solutions using JAX. To achieve this and provide an excellent user experience, you have strong programming skills and excellent system design skills. You should have excellent communication and planning skills for this role. Come join us to build the next generation of tooling that will advance the numerical computing and machine learning research around the world!

What you will be doing:

• Play meaningful role in NVIDIA 's effort in contributing to JAX.

• Design and implement JAX core components and drive peak performance on NVIDIA products.

• Work with AI applied researchers and leaders to build future-proof models

• Build tools that will increase the efficiency of teams developing AI-based systems.

• Work to bridge the gap between the latest in numerical computing, simulation and deep learning research and their applications in real world products.

What we need to see:

• BS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 6+ years relevant experience.

• C/C++ and Python programming.

• Experience with machine learning frameworks and their internals (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, etc.).

• Proven ability developing customer-facing solutions, balancing feature requests and bugs.

• Proven technical foundation in CPU and GPU architectures, numeric libraries, modular software design.

• Highly motivated with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to work successfully with multi-functional teams, principles and architects. Coordinates effectively across organizational boundaries and geographies.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Understanding of JAX, Autograd, tracing, code generation and DSL compilers and their design.

• Understanding of deep learning training in distributed contexts: multi-GPU, multi-node, synchronous vs asynchronous.

• Background with software shipping cycles (dev, deploy, release, CI).

• Experience building distributed systems and services at large scale.

Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. </li

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Protection Applications
description:
Overview
The Senior Electrical Engineer will lead electrical design teams to deliver high-quality designs for new developments, upgrades, and redevelopments across a wide range of sectors, including power, process, healthcare, transportation, industrial, manufacturing, government, and institutional facilities. This role oversees all phases of design and construction, ensuring electrical plans align with project budgets, technical standards, and client objectives.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead and execute complex electrical engineering projects using advanced techniques to develop new or improved systems, equipment, and methodologies.

• Coordinate departmental or divisional design assignments, studies, and reports.

• Perform detailed power system studies and system protection settings coordination for projects up to the 500-kV level.

• Develop design basis documentation for protective settings and create native relay configuration files.

• Conduct design reviews and support quality assurance efforts.

• Collaborate with project managers to define scope and develop conceptual designs.

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers.

• Contribute to business development and proposal efforts.

Qualifications

• Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, plus a minimum of seven (7) years of experience in electrical system studies within the electric utility or industrial power distribution sector.

• Experience developing protective relay settings in transmission or distribution systems.

description:

As a Supplier Sourcing & Procurement Specialist you will take ownership of all supplier-related communication. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.
The companys portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In this role

You will work independently to manage deals from pipeline development through close, partnering with account managers and internal business teams to develop proposals, address customer objections, and establish effective deal strategies. This role requires a proactive sales professional who can build customer relationships, maintain accurate forecasts, manage renewal timelines, and deliver measurable results in a remote, fast-paced environment. You will also contribute to expanding access to technology, training, and services that help education and nonprofit organizations succeed in an AI-driven economy.

• Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, overseeing service renewals, new contract opportunities, and sales activities from initial engagement through deal closure.

• Coordinate with sales, customer success, and service delivery teams to support customer satisfaction, resolve concerns, and improve the overall customer experience.

• Track and improve key performance indicators, including on-time renewals, renewal rates, and recapture rates.

title: GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM)
description:
About the Job:
AI-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse.
This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high-quality data.
Responsibilities:

• Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains.

• Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems.

• Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations.

• Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact.

• Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling.

• Provide trusted, well-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls.

•
Who You'll Work With: Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2+ years leading MDM or data quality programs.

• Hands-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe.

• Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale.

• Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs.

• Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of delivering cross-functional programs without direct authority.

•
Nice to Have

• Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts.

• Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML-assisted or LLM-assisted matching and cleansing.

• Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2.
